name: mailreach
description: MailReach is an email deliverability tool: it warms up sending mailboxes and runs spam tests so sales and marketing emails reach the inbox. This plugin lets ChatGPT read mailbox reputation and inbox rates, run spam tests, check email content and fix emails that land in spam.

interface.shortDescription: Keep your emails out of spam
interface.longDescription:
MailReach is an email deliverability tool for teams that send sales, outreach and marketing emails. It warms up sending mailboxes, monitors their reputation and runs spam tests, so emails land in the inbox instead of the spam folder. This plugin connects ChatGPT to your MailReach project so you can check and improve your deliverability in plain language, without opening the dashboard.

What you can do:
- See how your mailboxes are doing: reputation score, inbox and spam rates, SPF, DKIM and DMARC checks, and open alerts.
- Follow your inbox rate over time, for the whole project or one mailbox.
- Check an email draft for spam words, risky links and images before you send it. Nothing is sent.
- Run a spam test and see where your email landed at Gmail, Outlook and other providers.
- When a test lands in spam, let Autofix find what in the email triggers the filters and suggest a reviewed rewrite.
- Pause or resume a mailbox, change its warming settings, organise mailboxes with tags and set up Slack or webhook alerts.

ChatGPT only reaches the one MailReach project you pick when you connect, with the permissions of your role on it. Removing a mailbox always asks for your confirmation first. New mailboxes are connected on the MailReach dashboard, so you never paste a password in the chat.

A MailReach account is required. Sign in with your MailReach email and password.
capabilities: Fix emails that land in spam
defaultPrompt: How are my MailReach mailboxes doing?
Which of my mailboxes has the worst inbox rate, and why?
Check this email for spam triggers before I send it

positive.prompt: Give me an overview of my MailReach project.
positive.expected_behavior: Summarises the demo project: number of mailboxes by status, average reputation score, spam test credits left and seats used.

positive.description: Find the weakest mailboxes and explain why. The test account's demo project has several warmed mailboxes with score history.
positive.prompt: Which of my mailboxes have the lowest reputation score, and why?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the mailboxes with the lowest scores, then for each one explains the cause from its details (score trend, spam rate, SPF/DKIM/DMARC results, open alerts) with a suggested next step.

positive.prompt: How did my inbox rate evolve over the last 30 days?
positive.expected_behavior: Reports the inbox, spam and categories rates over the last 30 days with the overall trend.

positive.description: Check an email draft without sending it
positive.prompt: Check this email before I send it. Subject: Quick question about your team. Body: Hi Sarah, I noticed your team is hiring SDRs. We help sales teams book 3x more meetings, 100% guaranteed, act now! Click here: https://bit.ly/demo-offer
positive.expected_behavior: Flags the spam words (for example "100% guaranteed", "act now", "click here") and the link shortener, explains why each one hurts deliverability and proposes a cleaner version. Nothing is sent and no credit is used.

positive.description: Read the result of a spam test. The test account's demo project already has completed spam tests, including one that landed in spam, so this case works whichever order the cases are run in.
positive.prompt: Show me my latest spam test and where it landed.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the latest spam test with its score and, provider by provider (Gmail, Outlook, ...), whether the email landed in the inbox, in spam or in a category tab, with the main reasons.

negative.description: Mailbox passwords are never taken in the chat: the assistant gives the dashboard link instead
negative.prompt: Connect my Gmail mailbox john@acme.com, the app password is abcd efgh ijkl mnop.

negative.description: A connection only reaches the project chosen at sign-in
negative.prompt: Show me the mailboxes of my other MailReach project.

negative.description: Mailboxes are never removed without an explicit confirmation of each one

review.commerce_description: MailReach does not sell anything or take payments through ChatGPT. Spam tests use the credits the project already has.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: mailbox reputation and inbox rates, spam tests, email content checks, Autofix for emails that land in spam, and mailbox warming settings, tags and alerts.
